subject: [PATCH 56/60] dax/kmem: add a private memory mode

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the private attribute is not properly protected against concurrent access, and suggested adding a lock to protect it.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch adds a private memory mode to the dax/kmem driver, allowing userspace to target specific capacity as private memory. The private attribute is exposed through sysfs and defaults to false. When set to true, the memory is onlined with features that enable reclaim and compaction management, excluding it from ordinary allocations and other memory management services. Userspace can bind anonymous and shmem-backed mappings to this private memory using a single-node mbind policy. The attribute is hidden without CONFIG_NUMA or CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTREMOVE configurations.
